subject: Post-call: MAP draft & security evidence pipeline (SOC 2 pack)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudray.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@cloudray.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: MAP draft & security evidence pipeline

Thanks for your time this morning — quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone for the security review and SOC 2 evidence exchange. Please review and flag anything missing.

Key outcomes from the call:
- Cloudray will do an internal security review and run the SOC 2 questionnaire with your security operations team.
- Redwood will provide a SOC 2 package (questionnaire, controls mapping, sample artifacts) and a draft evidence index for faster intake.
- We agreed on a target close date for procurement/signature once security review is complete: 2026-08-20 (tentative).

Draft MAP milestone (security & SOC 2):
1) Deliver SOC 2 package to Cloudray (Redwood) 
   - Owner: aditya_rao (Redwood)
   - Deliverable: Cloudray_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, controls-mapping doc, evidence-index.csv
   - Due: 2026-07-10
2) Cloudray completes questionnaire & flags evidence requests (Cloudray)
   - Owner: Elena Torres
   - Deliverable: completed questionnaire, list of requested artifacts
   - Due: 2026-07-17
3) Secure evidence upload & review (mutual)
   - Owner: marissa_cole (Redwood) / Cloudray security point-of-contact
   - Deliverable: shared secure folder link, initial evidence bundle
   - Due: 2026-07-24
4) Final security sign-off & procurement ready (Cloudray/procurement)
   - Owner: Michael Chen / procurement@cloudray.com
   - Deliverable: security acceptance note; procurement checklist complete
   - Due: 2026-08-03

Dependencies / notes:
- Cloudray requested evidence be shared via an encrypted Drive folder and that we label items with the evidence-index.csv ID.
- If the security review requires more artifacts, we agreed to triage requests weekly to avoid blocking procurement.

Attachments: MAP-Cloudray-Draft-v1.xlsx (MAP timeline), Cloudray_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, evidence-index.csv (stub)

Next steps:
- I’ll upload the package by EOD 7/10 and share the secure Drive link.
- Elena, please loop in your security reviewer and confirm the security POC by 7/12 so we can coordinate uploads.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudray.com>

Date: 2026-07-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: MAP draft & security evidence pipeline

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement will need confirmation that evidence will be delivered to a FedRAMP-compliant storage endpoint or via an encrypted Drive link. Can you confirm how Redwood will deliver artifacts and whether files will be under strict access controls?
- Our security reviewer is Priya Kulkarni (priya.k@cloudray.com) — I’ve CC'd procurement separately (procurement@cloudray.com).
- We should carve out time for a 30-minute follow-up next week if there are outstanding evidence items.

I’ll aim to have the questionnaire back to you by 7/17 but please send the package to the secure Drive link as soon as it’s available. Also: is there an example evidence labeling convention you prefer (file ID mapping to evidence-index.csv)?

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of IT Security | Cloudray Technologies
elena.torres@cloudray.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudray.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@cloudray.com>, procurement@cloudray.com
Date: 2026-07-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: MAP draft & security evidence pipeline

Quick internal note and confirmation on delivery model — forwarding to Cloudray for visibility.

Aditya — we will: 
- Put the SOC 2 package and sample artifacts in a dedicated, encrypted Google Drive folder with restricted access and audit logging.
- Add file-level metadata that matches the evidence-index.csv ID and include a short README in the folder explaining the mapping convention (example: EVID-001_access_logs.tar.gz -> evidence-index.csv row 1).
- Provide a separate hashed delivery record (SHA256) for each archive if Cloudray requires checksum verification.

I’ll create the folder and share the secure link to everyone on this thread by 7/10 EOD. Once Elena confirms Priya as the security POC, we’ll grant view + download to the named reviewers only.

Attachments: none in this reply (we’ll add the drive link in the next message).

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudray.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@cloudray.com>, procurement@cloudray.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, priya.k@cloudray.com
Date: 2026-07-14T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: MAP draft & security evidence pipeline — updated commitments

Thanks everyone — quick update and agreed items after internal check: 

1) Delivery: secure Drive folder created and shared. Link: https://drive.google.com/secure/drive/folders/1aB-Redwood-Cloudray-SOC2 (access: named reviewers only).
2) Timeline update: small tweak to allow for any follow-on evidence requests
   - Redwood deliver SOC 2 package: 2026-07-10 (completed)
   - Cloudray completes questionnaire: 2026-07-17 (target)
   - Initial evidence upload & review: 2026-07-24 (target)
   - Procurement / security acceptance: 2026-08-03 (target)
   - Procurement signature / contract close (target close date): 2026-08-20

3) Owners confirmed: aditya_rao (Redwood engagement lead) / marissa_cole (evidence coordination) / Elena (Cloudray security POC) / Michael + procurement@cloudray.com (procurement).

4) Dependencies: If Priya requires auditor-style artifacts beyond what we provided (e.g., anonymized logs covering specific date ranges), we’ll triage those requests in weekly checkpoint calls and aim to deliver within 5 business days of request.

Next steps for this week:
- Marissa to grant access and post the README + evidence-index.csv into the folder (done).
- Elena / Priya to confirm reviewer list and procurement contact (please confirm by 7/12).
- I’ll add the MAP-Cloudray-Draft-v1.xlsx to the deal record in HubSpot and set the deal close target to 2026-08-20. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/CR-4827

If there are no objections, I’ll schedule a 30-minute check-in for 7/20 to review outstanding items and remaining blockers.

Cheers — Aditya
